content: DeepWiki (Cognition/Devin) auto-generates wiki-style docs for any public GitHub repo - replace github.com with deepwiki.com. Ships: generated structured pages, architecture diagrams and flowcharts, navigation, and interactive Q&A over the generated wiki. Steerable via a .devin/wiki.json in the repo root - if pages are specified, exactly those pages are created. Two transferable lessons: (1) the auto-generated wiki plus Q&A-over-the-wiki combination is the proven shape of this product class; (2) users want to steer the page taxonomy rather than accept whatever the LLM decided - a compile-scope/outline control is a real feature, not a nicety.
